The plate is a square side plate of about 22 cm. The food is the white mass on the right (likely scrambled egg whites or egg-white omelet, not cheese) and roasted potato cubes on the left.

The white pieces look fluffy and slightly glossy, with pepper flecks, which fits cooked egg whites. Mozzarella would look smoother and more solid. I am going with egg whites at about 55 kcal/100 g.

Egg white portion: it covers roughly 10 x 11 cm and is about 2.5 cm high. That is about 150 g.

Potatoes: they cover about 8 x 9 cm and are about 2.5 cm high, with the cubes loosely packed. That is about 110 g. They are browned and look roasted or pan-fried with a little oil, so I use 150 kcal/100 g.
